record.question: What is the same process as of medical audit?
record.explanation: Answer A: Qualitative analysis. Medical audit is a review of the quality/content of care documented in records; qualitative analysis is the closest equivalent among the options. Source/context note: “Same process” is imprecise; medical audit and qualitative analysis are related but not identical in every framework. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
